adjudication.rationale: In `apps/web/pages/api/webhook/app-credential.ts`, the handler decrypts and parses `reqBody.keys` via `JSON.parse(symmetricDecrypt(...))` with no try/catch or error handling around either operation. If `symmetricDecrypt` throws (e.g., wrong/empty `CALCOM_APP_CREDENTIAL_ENCRYPTION_KEY`, invalid ciphertext) or if the decrypted plaintext is not valid JSON, `JSON.parse` will throw and Next.js will return an unhandled 500 response rather than the explicit `{ message }` JSON used elsewhere in this endpoint (e.g., 403/404 branches). This behavior is directly visible from the diff and represents a real robustness/correctness issue for malformed input.
